_doc: Fixed value lists for the adult app (SPEC 5.9, 6, 7 and 9). The profile stores these values, never free text. The schemas repeat these lists as enums, and contracts/tests/contracts.test.mjs checks that they match. Changing a list used by the profile bumps PROFILE_V. Labels shown to people live in the app, not here.

years._doc: Years in one role (profile roles[].years), on the same bands as the SPEC 7.2 level thresholds (<2, 2-5, 5-8, 8-12, 12-18, 18+). 'a-b' means at least a and under b whole years, so '0-2' is under 2 years; '18+' means 18 or more. The SPEC 6 example uses '5-8'. Owner decision D2.

level._doc: Seniority level of a role, 1 (entry) to 6 (head, director, VP). Worked out by the app from SPEC 7.2 and stored as a number.

industry._doc: Industry of a role (SPEC 3, decision D1). 'it' covers IT services, engineering R&D, software products, GCC technology functions and IT management. 'bpm' is BPM / ITeS. 'bfsi' is banking, financial services and insurance (technology, operations, analytics, risk, BFSI GCCs). 'other' is anything else.

strength._doc: How well the person knows a skill (SPEC 6 and 7.1): strong = 1.0, used = 0.7, rusty = 0.4.

lead_people._doc: How many people the person leads (profile lead.people). SPEC 7.2 adds a level for 6 or more, so the bands split at 6.

hours_month._doc: Study hours a month the person can give (constraints.hours_month). The SPEC 6 example uses '5-10'.

course_budget._doc: Course budget in rupees (constraints.course_budget). 'free' means free courses only; k = thousand, L = lakh. The SPEC 6 example uses '10k-50k'.

pay_floor_pct._doc: Lowest pay change the person accepts, in percent of today's pay (constraints.pay_floor_pct). A number, not a string. The SPEC 6 example uses -10. Leave the field out for no floor.

mode._doc: Preferred work mode (constraints.mode). 'any' means no preference.

city_cluster._doc: City cluster ids (SPEC 5.9), stored instead of any address (profile constraints.city). Every id has the prefix 'city:', like every other graph id (owner decision D3). Metros: blr Bengaluru, hyd Hyderabad, pnq Pune, maa Chennai, ncr Delhi NCR, bom Mumbai, ccu Kolkata, amd Ahmedabad. Tier 2: cjb Coimbatore, cok Kochi, jai Jaipur, idr Indore, bbi Bhubaneswar, vtz Visakhapatnam, trv Thiruvananthapuram, ixc Chandigarh, nag Nagpur, mys Mysuru. 'city:other' is anywhere else in India. data/graph/raw/cities.json must use exactly these ids, each with its state.

open_to._doc: Places the person would work (constraints.open_to): any city_cluster id above, plus three choices that are not a city, each with the prefix 'open:' so they can never clash with a city id: 'open:india' (anywhere in India), 'open:remote' (remote only) and 'open:abroad'. 'Same city' is the person's own cluster id. Used only for the needs_relocation flag (ADR-16).

priority_keys._doc: Keys of profile.priorities (SPEC 6 and 7.3). short_move is the 'short' component (coverage).

priority_weight._doc: Weight of one priority slider, a whole number from 0 (ignore) to 5. The SPEC 6 example uses 0 and 1.

age_band._doc: Age band kept for an adult tester instead of a birth year (SPEC 3 and 10). Under 18 is refused and never stored. Never part of the profile or the matcher (ADR-16).

need_kind._doc: Kind of a skill-like node in a slice or in skills_index.json: O*NET skill, knowledge or work activity, or a technology.

skill_ai_label._doc: Skill AI label (SPEC 5.5): ai_does_much = 'AI already does much of this' (share 0.5 or more), people_do = 'people still do this' (0.15 or less), mixed = in between, unknown = no task data.

ai_task_mode._doc: AI use on a task (SPEC 5.5). none = no use was observed; unknown = no data.

road_reach._doc: How close a road is by coverage (SPEC 7.3): adjacent 0.7 or more, stretch 0.4 to 0.7, leap under 0.4.

road_flag._doc: Constraint flags on a road (SPEC 5.9 and 7.3). They are shown and never hide a road.

experience_fit._doc: Experience fit against the target level's year band (SPEC 7.2).

maturity._doc: Maturity of a new AI-era role (SPEC 5.7).

intake_source._doc: Where the experience came from (intake event): a file upload, pasted text, or a typed job title.

intake_mode._doc: Reading mode (SPEC 8 screen 4): most_accurate (redacted text to the AI read), on_device, or none (title route).

feedback_about._doc: What a feedback event is about.

error_code._doc: Stable error codes in the API error envelope (SPEC 9), in the order of ERRORS in hosting/core/http.js (a test checks they are equal). ADR-09 names rate_limited, invalid_code, expired, conflict, not_found, bad_request and unavailable; the others are added and logged in docs/adult/deviations.md: too_large (413, body over the limit), unauthorized (401, no valid session), forbidden (403), refused_age (403, under 18 at sign-up) and internal (500, our bug).

registry_kind._doc: Node kinds in data/graph/id_registry.json (SPEC 5.2). Technology ids (tec:) use kind 'skill'.

registry_status._doc: Status of an id in the registry (ADR-05).
